title: Toader–Qi mean versus the 3/2-order logarithmic mean conjecture
statement:
Let $a,b>0$ with $a\neq b$. The $p$-order logarithmic mean is defined by

$$
L_p(a,b)=L\left(a^p,b^p\right)^{1/p}.
$$

**Toader–Qi/logarithmic-mean conjecture.** The inequality

$$
TQ(a,b)>L_{3/2}(a,b)
$$

holds. The conjecture is motivated by the known inequality $L(a,b)^{3/4}A(a,b)^{1/4}<L_{3/2}(a,b)$ and the corresponding established lower bound for the Toader–Qi mean; its status is not resolved in the supplied source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.05430

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2015).
source_name: Zhen-Hang Yang, “Some sharp inequalities for the Toader-Qi mean”, arXiv:1507.05430 (2015).
